Enjoy The Evergreen Melody “Jenina Holeyo” From The Classic Kannada Movie Chalisuva Modagalu, Featuring Dr. Rajkumar, Ambika, And Saritha.
Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema With This Beautiful Lyrical Song Composed By The Legendary Music Director Duo Rajan-Nagendra. Sing Along With The Lyrics And Enjoy The Timeless Charm Of Kannada Old Songs, Brought To You By MRT Music.
Song: Jenina Holeyo
Album/Movie: Chalisuva Modagalu
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Ambika, Saritha, Puneeth Rajkumar
Singer: Dr Rajkumar
Music Director: Rajan-Nagendra
Lyricist: Chi. Udayashankar
